rule: net-negative on SOURCE lines; existing suite must pass UNMODIFIED
finding: Path- and shape-coupled test assertions had been cementing the monoliths. Five distinct failure modes were found: (1) a split BLOCKED - postgres counts a regex over src/index.ts, slack requires every api() call site in it, nats pins prose into it; (2) a guard SILENTLY HOLLOWED - matrix's negative assertions on src/index.ts still pass but now grade a file that no longer contains the code they were written about; (3) a debt made INVISIBLE - net-util's fork registry keyed by file path and scanned only importing files, so a split could retire a recorded security debt with the suite green; (4) a shape lock - redis's test asserts a private field is an Array, so a ReaderPool failed 20 tests on shape not behaviour; (5) a lint with a hole - zulip's export-surface regex misses `export async function`, proven by a real export it failed to flag.
caveat: Margins are thin (xmpp -3, shared -5) because a multi-file split costs 30-50 lines of irreducible import ceremony. The reductions came mostly from duplication the split REVEALED, not from the move.

agentsThatDiedBeforeReporting.note: Work was complete, staged, typechecking and suite-green; verified and landed from the artifact alone. The unmodified-suite rule means behaviour preservation is established by the suite rather than by the agent's account, so the decomposition stayed reviewable. What was lost is the prose report - the defects found and left alone, and the structural constraints hit.
